title: Scholarship for Foreign Students
field: Graduate studies (Master and PhD) at Japanese universities

compensation.value: Monthly stipend of ¥180,000 to ¥230,000 depending on programme length
compensation.evidence_quote: ¥230,000 per month for 1–2 years, ¥210,000 for 3 years, and ¥180,000 for 4–5 years

about: The Honjo International Scholarship Foundation offers a non-repayable monthly stipend to non-Japanese graduate students at Japanese universities for programmes starting April 2027. Applications run online from 1 September to 31 October 2026; interviews are in early February 2027 and results on 31 March 2027.
requirements: Enrolled or applying for a graduate programme at a Japanese university starting April 2027
card_alt: Card for the Scholarship for Foreign Students from the Honjo International Scholarship Foundation, Japan; deadline 31 Oct 2026. The background is the default city skyline photo.
